title: The Frost Shrine
text: A shrine of ice to a winter god, its altar glittering blue. Offerings lie frozen into it, layer on layer: coins, a sword, a lock of hair, a child's doll with its arms out. The doll's eyes have frost on the lashes.

options.label: Leave an offering of your own.

outcomes.text: The coin freezes into the altar. The wind drops for a day.

options.label: The strongest pries the sword from the ice.

outcomes.text: Cold steel that never dulls, and never warms.
The god takes something back, in ice, from the hand that took the sword.

options.label: The devout prays to the winter god.

outcomes.text: The winter god listens, and the cold becomes a kind of strength.
